C:P1.1.text: Legence | Building Performance Platform | Engineering, HVAC & Sustainability Solutions

C:P1.2.text: Legence is the largest pure-play building performance platform — delivering engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance for mission-critical facilities. 20+ brands, nationwide.

C:P1.3.text: Learn how Legence partners with clients to deliver innovative solutions that enhance building performance and drive efficiency.

C:P1.4.text: Building Better for mission-critical & High-Growth sectors

C:P1.5.text: Legence partners with clients to deliver innovative solutions that enhance building performance, improve reliability, and drive efficiency.

C:P1.6.text: We are a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. We focus on high-growth sectors with technically demanding buildings, including technology, life sciences, healthcare, and education.

C:P1.7.text: Combining cutting edge engineering solutions with expert craftsmanship to deliver exceptional results.

C:P1.8.text: With a team of MEP engineers and consultants, we deliver unparalleled expertise and innovation across new and existing buildings.

C:P1.10.text: Through net zero building design, we deliver high‑performance solutions and more than 140 MW of distributed generation.

C:P1.11.text: Our expert team includes HVAC and plumbing service technicians, fitters, electricians, and sheet metal workers.

C:P1.12.text: As a sustainability consulting advisor, we maximize efficiency across square footage in more than 25,000 buildings.

C:P1.13.text: With in-house engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance expertise and decades of experience, we ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.

C:P1.14.text: Powering the infrastructure behind always-on digital operations, from new construction to ongoing facility performance.

C:P1.15.text: Specialized systems for fabrication environments where precision, consistency, and operational control are critical.

C:P1.16.text: Building systems expertise for facilities where production demands leave little room for disruption.

C:P1.17.text: Facilities that support research, testing, and discovery require carefully controlled environments and dependable operation.

C:P1.18.text: Supporting hospitals and healthcare facilities with building systems that keep critical services available when they matter most.

C:P1.19.text: Helping K-12 and higher-ed campuses create environments that support students, faculty, research programs, and daily operations.

C:P1.20.text: Engineering and infrastructure services for facilities that deliver essential services to communities every day.

C:P1.21.text: Supporting owners and operators with building systems that keep workplaces, mixed-use properties, and commercial assets performing as intended.

C:P1.22.text: Our Engineering & Consulting teams design HVAC and MEP systems, develop energy-saving strategies to make buildings more sustainable, and provide program/project management services for customers’ installation and retrofit projects.

C:P1.23.text: Our Installation & Maintenance technicians and craftspeople fabricate and install HVAC systems, process piping and other MEP systems in new and existing industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings and provide ongoing preventative and corrective maintenance services for those systems.
